name: Caribbean Cruise "Pearls of the Caribbean" (Crabmeat, Shrimp & Salmon in Pearl Couscous)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure, Magic & Wonder · Caribbean / Pirate Night Menu
whyItWorks: Chilled crabmeat, poached shrimp, and smoked salmon layered with soft refined-wheat Israeli pearl couscous—a lean, low-fiber seafood starter.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request it without the lemon-grass infused vinaigrette (or with olive oil on the side) to keep it 100% citrus-safe.
watchOuts: CITRUS WARNING: Standard dressing is a lemon-grass/citrus vinaigrette
